settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Giants and Eagles, scheduled for November 8 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Giants" if the Giants win the game by 6 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Eagles".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Packers and Patriots, scheduled for November 8 at 4:25 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Packers" if the Packers win the game by 7 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Patriots".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
